_comment: THE RE-SEAL RECORD, box 2.1.15. The two artifacts emitted from this corpus are
re-sealed IN PLACE: no filename moves, no eighth artifact appears, the sidecar
count stays 7, and wrapper_file is neither renamed nor removed -- mcp/gateway.py
and naming.py join on it and dispatch breaks if it moves. An in-place re-seal
therefore leaves no trace of its own, which is the reason this file exists.
The two digests below are the bytes that were sealed BEFORE this re-seal, read
from the committed tree on 2026-08-26 with
git show HEAD:engine/artifacts/node-specs.sha256
git show HEAD:engine/artifacts/method-cards.sha256
They are authored rather than computed, because a generator that reads git
cannot run where this one has to: .dockerignore excludes .git/ and the image
build runs the whole suite. tests/test_gen_artifacts.py keeps the same pair as a
second, independent home, so a digest edited to something that never existed is
caught rather than believed.
This block is emitted onto BOTH artifacts, identically. One re-seal, one record.
ONE RECORD, NOT A LOG. This block names the bytes the LAST re-seal superseded
and nothing before them. A growing list was considered and left alone: git
already holds every prior version of both sidecars, and the one question this
block answers that git cannot answer inside the image -- what these bytes
replaced -- takes exactly one pair of digests.
THE 2026-08-26 RE-SEAL FOR BOX 2.1.1.12 replaces, in 46 cards, a `sources`
entry naming a distribution the register measured as not implementing that
card's method, with that row's own library or paper.
THE TWO ARTIFACTS MOVE BY VERY DIFFERENT AMOUNTS, AND THAT IS WORTH NAMING SO
A REVIEWER READS THE PAIR CORRECTLY. `sources` is a CARD field, so
method-cards.json moves by 93 lines -- 46 `sources` entries and the 46
`embed_text` blobs that carry them into retrieval. Nothing in node-specs.json's
catalogue changes at all: it moves by exactly the two lines of this block, which
is emitted onto both artifacts. A re-seal is still a re-seal when one side moves
only by its own record, and both digests below are the committed bytes each file
superseded, read from the tree with
git show HEAD:engine/artifacts/node-specs.sha256
git show HEAD:engine/artifacts/method-cards.sha256
NO CONTRACT HASH MOVES, which is a property of the hash rather than a hope --
contract_hash.py projects a node onto fn, arguments, register and export by
name, and a card's `sources` is none of them and is not even in the same
artifact. Proved rather than argued, by dumping `fn<TAB>hash` for all 1456 nodes
before and after:
